title: Loren C
content: I was visiting my meditation coach and therapist. She works with PTSD (which I don’t have). We wanted to see what her technique would do for a healthy, normal person. We were prepared for a surprise, and we got one. I was lying propped up on some pillows, wearing an eye mask and going as deep as I could with her coaching. She and her partner were seated in front of me on the floor. Without any preliminary thoughts or sensations, the only rational interpretation is that I woke up on the other side. The first thing that hit me was overwhelming beauty, then love, then peace and light. It was completely overwhelming. I’ve read numerous books on astral travel but was never able to achieve it. None of the books said anything about the incredibly intense feeling I was experiencing. I rate this experience 1000 on a scale of 0 to 10. It still chokes me up three years later. My body was lying horizontal when I "opened my eyes." I saw four entities in the form of glowing, gold-colored, human-sized clouds. The space was filled with a bright, golden light. I was barely able to keep it together, when I asked them how they could stand to live there. They replied, "How can you stand to live where you do?" When I returned to my body after about five seconds, my therapist and her partner were glowing with a six-inch aura. This has been the most intense experience of my life.
